correctness.rationale: For nonzero a and odd prime p, X^8+Y^8=aZ^8 is a smooth genus-21 projective plane curve; Hasse--Weil and at most eight rational points at infinity imply at least p-7-42 sqrt(p) affine solutions, positive from p=1783 onward. The integer-only checker enumerates every one of the 275 primes through 1777, computes every eighth-power image and twofold sumset, confirms the exact 14-entry exception table, cross-checks modular power images by repeated squaring, and verifies the bound. p=2 and a=0 are explicitly covered. This is finite exhaustive verification plus a universal theorem, not extrapolation.

value.rationale: The two-term modular Waring surjectivity problem is natural and directly motivated in the 2023 paper. The complete eighth-power prime classification provides a sharp permanence threshold p=769, an explicit last obstruction p=761 and 11 genuinely octic exception counts not implied by the quartic special case. It closes a precise finite gap between classical eventual existence and exact prime-field behavior; a complete classification is valuable without a downstream theorem.
